## Invitations

Of the 1794 people invited, 1103 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 61.5 per cent. The figures provide a straightforward summary of participation during the reporting period and indicate the proportion of invited people who came to their appointment.

The invitation process did not include SMS contact. A total of 0 invitations were sent by SMS. The attendance information is recorded alongside the invitation figures so that participation can be reviewed against the number of people invited.

## Contact

No reminder messages were issued. The number of people who received a reminder was 0. Staff continue to phone people who missed two appointments, maintaining contact with those who did not attend as expected.

This approach supports follow-up after missed appointments and provides an opportunity for staff to re-establish contact. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
